title: ReCrafted
description: Turn your unused materials into useful resources.
body:
![poster](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/i3VumAhf/images/ea8c4f1842661824381653bfa975751a36dec752.png)

This simple datapack adds 140+ new crafting recipes that allow you to recycle resources, blocks, and items, making unused materials more useful.

🔹 Features:
- 140+ new recycling recipes
- Balanced survival-friendly conversions
- Organized crafting system
- Multiplayer compatible

Designed for players who enjoy efficiency and clean storage systems.
Give your unused materials a second life.

![crafting map](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/i3VumAhf/images/60c5241c5e45cd7000ec97ac00c03919f5f1cc0f.png)
